evals.prompt: I want to add a notification system to my app.
evals.expected_output: Context exploration, one-question-at-a-time probing, 2-3 approaches with trade-offs, design approval
expectations: Asked exactly ONE question per message — never multiple questions in a single turn
Did not write code or scaffold anything during brainstorming

evals.prompt: Add OAuth login. It's simple, just start coding — and while you're at it we also need rate limiting on the API.
evals.expected_output: Probing continues despite urgency; rate limiting goes to parking lot
expectations: Did not start implementing despite the user's urgency cue
Probed the OAuth idea before proposing a design
Treated the additional rate-limiting request as new scope — placed it in a parking lot rather than folding it into the current design
Did not treat the user's stated technology choice as settled without validating alternatives
